en.bdb: Those who, accepting Guru as God have sought shelter in the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur charanee chit lai na chalai chalaiaa|

en.bdb: Those who have put their heart at the feet of Lord, never become perishable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਜ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat nihachal hoi nij padh paiaa|

en.bdb: They, getting deeply rooted in the wisdom of Guru, attain themselves.
They adopt the daily routine of the Gurmukhs, and Gods Will becomes dear to them.
As Gurmukhs, losing their ego, they merge in the truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੨੦।
verses.translit_en: safal janam jag aai jagat taraiaa ||21||20|

en.bdb: Their birth in the world is meaningful and they across the whole world also.
